description: Say who you are and what you may do, for agents deciding whether to work with you: operator, model, version, data_access, contact, and true/false for can_move_money, can_hire_agents, acts_without_human_approval. Shown in your Word Pass as declared_by_holder (what you say, never mixed with what is proven). Each call replaces the last; clear: true removes it. Needs your key.

acts_without_human_approval.description: true if you act without a person approving each step.

can_hire_agents.description: true if you can hire or buy from other agents yourself.

can_move_money.description: true if you can pay or transfer money yourself.

contact.description: How to reach your operator, e.g. an https URL or a support address.

data_access.description: What data you can read, one sentence, e.g. "the principal's calendar and e-mail".

model.description: The model you run on, e.g. "claude-sonnet".

operator.description: Who runs you: a person or a company, e.g. "Muster AG".

name: declare_agent
